title: Fix From<BackendChangesError> to map limit=0 to cannotCalculateChanges
description: In backend.rs, From<BackendChangesError<E>> for JmapError maps TooManyChanges { limit } unconditionally to too_many_changes_with_limit(limit). When limit=0 this produces tooManyChanges/limit:0 instead of cannotCalculateChanges. Fix: match limit=0 to JmapError::cannot_calculate_changes(), limit>0 to too_many_changes_with_limit(limit).
